svg.title: ARM logo directions — comparison board
svg.desc: Four identity proposals with dark/light lockups and small-size checks. Carve is the initial recommendation.
svg.text: Make a finite resource feel well managed.
Four original vector directions for the agent resource manager.
Same palette and wordmark. Different ideas. No existing branding replaced.
One continuous pool; one separated slice.
Strongest small-size silhouette; less literal about time.
A grant has a beginning and an end.
An open cycle holds a distinct leased unit.
Communicates duration; can resemble a timer or sync utility.
An authoritative host connects two independent workloads.
Clear coordination; more detailed and closer to orchestration.
A resource inside a clear boundary.
Two facing brackets hold one precisely defined unit.
Excellent monochrome; may read as focus or source code.
It expresses the defining behavior: a bounded pool becomes an attributable allocation.
Held is the quieter developer-first alternative. Lease Loop emphasizes duration; Relay emphasizes hosts and mesh.
Vector symbols + custom path wordmark · 16 / 24 / 32 px checks · monochrome included · text terminals keep “arm”
